description: This file defines a simple Android ContentProvider named MmsFileProvider, which serves MMS files from the cache directory for messaging functionalities. It implements basic CRUD operations but only supports reading files via openFile.

classes.name: MmsFileProvider
classes.description: An Android ContentProvider subclass for serving MMS files from the app cache.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the content provider, returns true indicating successful creation.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Overrides ContentProvider.query, not supported in this provider, returns null.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Overrides ContentProvider.insert, not supported, returns null.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns null indicating no specific MIME type for served files.

methods.name: openFile
methods.description: Provides access to MMS files in cache directory for read/write as specified by 'fileMode'.
